notes: three «ح» branches, each ending before the meeting, which is «كلهم عن الجريري» (occurrence 2); the names after it are written once and form the shared tail; «شيخ، من طفاوة» is unnamed; Abu Hurayra is the last link (his words are relayed); «قال مؤمل في حديثه فتاة كعاب», «زاد موسى» and the closing «وقال موسى حدثنا حماد» are wording variants or restatements, left out
